title_authors: Partial molal volumes of MgCl2, CaCl2, SrCl2, and BaCl2 in aqueous solution to 200 deg; A. J. Ellis, DSIR Petone, New Zealand
experimental_method: Precise density change of solutions between 50 C and higher temperatures measured as in Ellis (1966) J. Chem. Soc. A 1579; densities at 50 C taken from International Critical Tables; total pressure 20 atm.
uncertainties_stated: densities significant to the fifth decimal (relative); a systematic change of 1 in the fourth decimal at 50 C changes limiting partial molal volume by 1-1.5 cc/mol
quality_remarks: Fifth decimal has relative significance only (arbitrary zero added to the 50 C literature densities). Temperature scale not stated. Only the 50 C column rests on literature densities. Table 2 phi0 values are free-hand extrapolations (error up to 2-3 cc/mol at 200 C).
not_extracted_tables: Table 2: limiting partial molal volumes (derived by extrapolation, from apparent molal volumes)
Table 3: total intrinsic volumes of ions (calculated)
Apparent molal volumes phi are only shown in Figures 1-4
